name: Nekojou Hinana
source:
A student at PochiTama’s Sapporo branch, where she is a pâtissière-in-training. Hinana is a gentle young lady, who can be a bit of an airhead and oddball at times.

She loves eating above all else, and can usually be found munching on something. She believed choosing such a profession would mean she would always have a full belly. Hinana's parents taught her how to cook at a very young age, and her skills as a pâtissière are that of a professional. After tasting a cake [url=/c54827]Kenta[/url] made, Hinana fell in love with the flavor and struggles day and night to replicate it.

She has an assertive and open-minded attitude when it comes to sex, and will partake in just about anything.

"Oh my, what a tasty-looking cake...! Just looking at it is making me drool. No need to slice the thing up. We can eat it whole, right?"
